name: 46226 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46226 (Indianapolis) has 174 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46226 (Indianapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
